What we repair

If it cools, washes, dries or cooks in your home, we can help. Tell us the symptom — we bring the tools, the parts knowledge and a straight quote.

Refrigerators & Freezers

Warm fridge, noisy compressor, leaking water or a freezer that won't hold temperature — we track down the real cause, from coils and fans to sealed-system issues.

  • Not cooling
  • Ice maker faults
  • Leaks
  • Coil cleaning

Washers & Dryers

Laundry piling up? We fix machines that won't spin, drain, heat or start — and dryers that take two cycles to do one load's work.

  • Won't spin or drain
  • No heat
  • Loud cycles
  • Error codes

Ovens, Ranges & Cooktops

Uneven baking, burners that won't ignite, error codes on the display — gas and electric, freestanding and built-in. We diagnose it and quote the repair on the spot.

  • Not heating
  • Igniter faults
  • Temperature off
  • Control boards

Dishwashers

Standing water, dishes coming out dirty, leaks on the kitchen floor or a cycle that never finishes — we find the fault and quote the fix on the spot.

  • Won't drain
  • Leaks
  • Poor cleaning
  • Won't start

Also on the truck: standalone freezers, ice makers, microwaves, garbage disposals and dryer vent cleaning. Not sure if we cover it? Call (435) 229-2792 and ask — if we can't fix it, we'll tell you straight.

Questions, answered

How much does a visit cost?+
The diagnostic visit is a flat $79. That covers the trip to your home and a full diagnosis. If you go ahead with the repair, the $79 is credited in full toward it. If you decide not to repair, you only pay the $79 — nothing more.
Which areas do you cover?+
We serve St. George, Utah and Mesquite, Nevada. If you're just outside either city, call (435) 229-2792 and ask — we'll let you know if we can make the trip.
What are your hours?+
Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. You can send an email request anytime at rudandcoappliance@gmail.com — we'll answer during business hours.
Which brands do you work on?+
All the major household brands: Samsung, LG, Whirlpool, GE, Maytag, KitchenAid, Bosch, Frigidaire, Electrolux, Kenmore, Amana and Speed Queen, among others. If your brand isn't listed, call and ask.
How do I book?+
Call or text (435) 229-2792, send the request form on this page, or email us. Tell us the appliance, the brand if you know it, and what's going wrong — that helps us arrive prepared.
Will you quote the repair before starting?+
Always. After the diagnostic you get one flat quote for parts and labor. Work only begins when you approve it — and your $79 diagnostic comes off that price.
